notes: Fixes dark-mode contrast across Firearms, firearm caliber summary, Range Sessions, Settings landing cards, configurable-list cards, drawers and editors.
Adds the ArmoryGrid image derivative pipeline with preserved original upload plus WebP thumb (320), card (720), drawer (1400), and large (2200) variants.
Existing images are backfilled automatically on startup; new uploads and replacements generate derivatives immediately.
Dashboard, firearm cards, Range Sessions, Media Library, image pickers and firearm image editor now request context-appropriate image sizes instead of full-resolution originals.
Adds physical 90-degree Rotate Left / Rotate Right operations in Media Library and firearm image editing; derivatives are regenerated after rotation.
Normalizes EXIF orientation while preserving the pristine uploaded file in the image sidecar store.
Adds no-cache revalidation for media so rotated/replaced images refresh correctly.
